en.headline: MTR says linked faults caused two Lam Tin disruptions in mid-October
en.dek: Preliminary findings point to a failed insulating component that sparked a fire on 13 October and an overloaded connection the next morning; the operator must submit a full report within a month.
body: The MTR Corporation said preliminary investigation findings show that two service disruptions at Lam Tin station on the Kwun Tong Line within about 15 hours earlier this month were linked.

According to papers submitted to the Legislative Council transport panel on Tuesday, a failed rubber insulating component on turnout-switch gear near the station on 13 October created an unintended conductive path, triggering a short circuit, sparks and fire. That incident left a portable earthing switch closed; the next morning the resulting overloaded busbar joint overheated cables in an electrical plant room, producing smoke and forcing trains to skip the station.

The Transport and Logistics Bureau and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department are involved in the inquiry. The government has instructed the MTR to file a detailed investigation report and improvement measures within one month. The operator said it has repaired the joint, replaced damaged cables and restored normal operation while further tests continue.

Under the Service Performance Rebate scheme the MTR sets aside funds for serious delays of 31 minutes or more within its control. Once the rebate account reaches HK$25 million a special half-fare day is arranged.

zh.headline: 港鐵指藍田站兩次事故由相關故障引致
zh.dek: 初步調查顯示10月13日絕緣膠失效引致短路起火，翌日接地開關未重置令電纜過載冒煙；政府要求一個月內提交詳細報告。
body: 港鐵公司表示，本月中觀塘綫藍田站在約15小時內發生的兩次服務中斷，初步調查顯示彼此相關。
港鐵向立法會交通事務委員會提交的文件指，10月13日藍田站附近道岔絕緣膠失效，形成非預期導電路徑，引致短路、火花及火警。事故後一個手提接地開關維持關閉狀態；翌日早上母線接頭因持續較高電流而過熱，電纜接地部分冒煙，列車須不停該站。
運輸及物流局及機電工程署參與調查。政府已指示港鐵在一個月內提交詳細調查報告及改善措施。港鐵表示已修復接頭、更換損毀電纜並恢復正常運作，同時繼續進行技術測試。
根據服務表現回贈計劃，港鐵須就屬其控制範圍內、延誤達31分鐘或以上的嚴重事故撥備款項。累計達2500萬元時會安排特別半價日。
更正：中文版誤植為荃灣綫，應為觀塘綫。
